dialogues.speaker: Greygory
dialogues.text: Diplomacy, finance, war, important personages, and the Veche arguing furiously for three hours before finally deciding to continue arguing next week.

dialogues.speaker: Greygory
dialogues.text: That sort of thing. For just a few Mora, you can learn which way Snezhnaya's fate is turning.

dialogues.speaker: Greygory
dialogues.text: Go on, take one. I can tell you care at least a little about the way things are going.
